html:
Using your sword as your only method of traversal, jump and slash your way through obstacles and hazards to master this unique platforming movement system!

Use the recoil from your sword swings to get from place to place and figure out the complexities of these deceivingly simple controls.

Features:

  • A simple 2 button + Joystick control scheme
  • Controller rebinding
  • No walking!
  • A short and sweet 20-40 minute experience
